inspiration: Palette-snap look: a retro palettization and a posterization shader (Assets/Shaders/DaggerfallRetroPalettization.shader, DaggerfallRetroPosterization.shader) give a limited-colour look. Recreate with our own ramps per biome rather than any fixed palette.

Camera-facing 2D figures in a 3D world: billboard shaders with batched draws (Assets/Shaders/DaggerfallBillboard.shader, DaggerfallBillboardBatch.shader). A cheap way to fill a scene with flat cut-out people and creatures, drawn with our own sprites.
Layered paper-doll preview (Assets/Shaders/DaggerfallPaperDoll.shader): equipped pieces stacked over a base figure in a UI panel. Good for showing armour and clothing clearly in the inventory.

Tile-based automap (Assets/Shaders/DaggerfallAutomap.shader, DaggerfallTilemap.shader, DaggerfallTilemapTextureArray.shader): the map is drawn from a texture array of tiles. Idea: a minimal ink-style map that reveals as the player walks.

Data-driven dungeon lighting (Assets/Scripts/Game/DungeonLightHandler.cs, Assets/Scripts/DungeonTextureTables.cs): room lights and texture choices come from tables. Recreate with our own light rigs and tables, not the original ones.
Pixel and SDF text (Assets/Shaders/DaggerfallPixelFont.shader, DaggerfallSDFFont.shader): crisp pixel-style lettering that stays sharp at any size. Good for a retro HUD title style.

Water tinted by time of day with a daytime and a night gradient texture (Assets/Standard Assets/Environment/Water (Basic)/Textures/). Idea: a gradient lookup that shifts water colour across the day, with our own gradient art.
Message-panel structure in quest scripts (layout tags, centred blocks, separate panels for offer, accept, complete): a useful pattern for our quest UI. Structure only; no text reused.

briefs.label: Snap-palette post pass
briefs.why: A limited colour ramp gives the whole world one unified retro look for little cost.
briefs.keep: one screen-space pass; banded shading; a fixed ramp
briefs.change: our own palette per biome; ordered dither instead of hard bands; a different ramp count
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: n/a (post effect); signature behaviour: palette snap; signature sound: none in donor. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Cut-out crowd
briefs.why: Flat figures that always face the camera fill a town fast and still read at distance.
briefs.keep: camera-facing sprites; batched draws; a soft ground blob
briefs.change: four-direction animated frames at our own pixel size; a rim light; a different silhouette
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: yes if the sprite is tall; signature behaviour: camera-facing sprite; signature sound: none in donor. Creature sprites are not in the box, so this is category-level only. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Stacked armour preview
briefs.why: Layered slots show what the player wears, so the inventory reads at a glance.
briefs.keep: stacked layers per slot over a base figure
briefs.change: our own slot order and armour materials; a turn-table preview instead of a fixed pose
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: yes (a full figure in a panel); signature behaviour: layer stacking; signature sound: none in donor. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Ink-reveal automap
briefs.why: A sparse map that uncovers as you walk gives a sense of exploration.
briefs.keep: a tile texture array; reveal as you walk
briefs.change: a hand-drawn ink line style; our own compass rose; a fog of memory in place of a grid
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: yes (a square panel); signature behaviour: reveal; signature sound: none in donor. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.

briefs.label: Room lamp rig
briefs.why: Light set per room from data gives each dungeon room its own mood cheaply.
briefs.keep: data tables pick the lights per room
briefs.change: our own torch colours and a flicker curve; coloured glass lamps
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: n/a (light); signature behaviour: per-room light switch; signature sound: none in donor. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
